initial_plan.can_answer: partly; it compares the composition of the recorded motorist-plus-cyclist deaths, but not their absolute counts or exposure-adjusted risk
initial_plan.metric: Annual share of the combined recorded motorist and cyclist deaths attributable to each road-user category; numerator is the category's killed-person sum and denominator is the sum of the motorist- and cyclist-killed columns
initial_plan.denominator: Within each calendar year, combined motorist plus cyclist deaths recorded in the two killed-person columns
initial_plan.population: Police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes dated 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31, limited to recorded motorist and cyclist deaths
initial_plan.grouping: Calendar year and road-user category (motorist or cyclist)

data_check.implications: Within the selected 2013-2025 population, crash_date has 0 missing values and 0 standard sentinel dates (1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, 9999-12-31); because it is typed DATE, text sentinels and impossible date strings are not applicable. Both killed-person columns have 0 missing rows, so no rows need to be dropped or imputed and the full recorded combined total can serve as the denominator. Every year has min/max dates from January 1 to December 31, so none is flagged as a partial year by the available date-boundary check. The annual crash-row population varies substantially, from 203,742 in 2013 to 85,546 in 2025; the composition share uses deaths rather than crash rows as its denominator and does not adjust for exposure.
data_check.decisions: Keep all crashes in the selected years; calculate each share from the available motorist and cyclist killed-person sums, with neither outcome column requiring imputation. Disclose that the denominator includes only these two recorded categories and that the shares do not show absolute totals or exposure-adjusted risk.

final_plan.can_answer: partly; it shows how recorded motorist and cyclist deaths divide between those two categories year by year, but does not compare absolute counts or exposure-adjusted risk
final_plan.metric: Annual share of recorded motorist-plus-cyclist deaths attributable to each category; numerator is that category's killed-person sum and denominator is the sum of the motorist- and cyclist-killed columns
final_plan.denominator: Within each calendar year, the combined recorded motorist and cyclist deaths, excluding no rows because neither column is missing
final_plan.population: All police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash records with crash_date in calendar years 2013-2025, limited in the metric to deaths recorded in the motorist and cyclist killed-person columns
filters: crash_date calendar year is 2013 through 2025; no other row filters
final_plan.grouping: Calendar year and road-user category: motorist or cyclist
final_plan.missing_data_decision: No missing values in either killed-person column among selected rows; retain all rows and calculate shares from the complete column sums.
final_plan.limitations: This is a composition measure limited to motorist and cyclist deaths in police-reported crash records; it cannot establish their absolute annual numbers, risk per traveler or exposure, or deaths outside these records. The check found 0 missing crash dates within selected years and 0 missing values in either killed-person column; observed date minima/maxima cover January 1 through December 31 in every year. Annual crash rows range from 203,742 (2013) to 85,546 (2025), although the share denominator is deaths in the two selected categories, not crash rows.
